name: IRLML6401
source: Infineon (IR) IRLML6401PbF データシート (2014-04-28 版)
description: P チャネル MOSFET −12V −4.3A (SOT-23, ピン1=G 2=S 3=D)。ロジックレベル駆動 (−1.8V でオン)。データシート (Infineon) の代表特性から作った等価モデル (レベル1 + 直列抵抗、ボディダイオードつき)

transfer.at: Fig 3 (伝達特性の代表特性、VDS = −12 V) の 25 °C (PDF の曲線の線から読んだ)

body_diode.at: Fig 7 (ソース・ドレイン間ダイオードの順方向の代表特性) の 25 °C (PDF の曲線の線から読んだ)

remarks: the table: VGS(th) -0.40 / -0.55 / -0.95 V (250 uA), RDS(on) max only: 50 / 85 / 125 mohm (-4.5 V -4.3 A, -2.5 V -2.5 A, -1.8 V -2 A); Ciss 830, Coss 180, Crss 125 pF (VGS = 0, VDS = -10 V, 1 MHz); gfs 8.6 S min; VSD max 1.2 V at 1.3 A

rds: the typ on resistances are not in the table: Fig 1 (output characteristics, 25 C) at -VDS = 0.2 V, the curves in the legend's order from the top (7, 5, 4.5, 3, 2.5, 1.8, 1.5, 1.0 V): 5.67 A at 4.5 V, 3.95 A at 2.5 V, 2.64 A at 1.8 V (each under the table's max)
transfer: Fig 3 (VDS = -12 V), the 25 C curve (the upper one above 1.3 V), read from its vector line
body_diode: Fig 7, the 25 C curve (the right one), 0.2 to 20 A

rds_temp: the data sheet's normalized on resistance against the junction temperature (2026-11-18): RD and RS became resistors with TC1 / TC2 fitted to it (without them the model's RDS(on) rose only by the channel's KP ~ T^-1.5)

rds_temp.at: Fig 4 (Normalized On-Resistance vs. Temperature、VGS = −4.5 V、ID = −4.3 A。PDF の曲線の線から読んだ)
